title: Comparison of two smooth sections over a trait
statement: Let R be a discrete valuation ring, g:P→Spec R smooth, quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and σ,τ sections. If τ at the closed point belongs to the connected component of σ in the closed fibre, then their points over the zero prime belong to the same connected component of the generic fibre.

source.place: Tag 055Q, last two paragraphs, using Tag 055J

proof.text: The source is locally noetherian. Its fibre is locally connected. Express the component C through the closed section point as O intersect the closed fibre F for an ambient open O. Put U=O union (P minus F), an open containing precisely C in the closed fibre.

In U take the connected component W of the closed point of σ. It is open because U is locally noetherian and hence locally connected. The preimage of C in U is preconnected, so it lies in W. Both closed section points lie in W. Every point of Spec R specializes to the closed point, so both sections factor through W.
The morphism W→Spec R is smooth, hence flat, and its closed fibre is reduced. W is connected by construction. Apply the connected-generic-fibre theorem to W.
The image of the connected generic fibre of W in P contains both generic section points and is contained in the generic fibre of P. Apply IsPreconnected.subset_connectedComponentIn.

    [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] {P : Scheme.{u}}

      connectedComponentIn (g ⁻¹' {(⟨⊥, Ideal.isPrime_bot⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R)})
